questions.solution:

M + 2 = O, O + 2 = Q, Q + 2 = S

G + 1 = H, H + 1 = I, I + 1 = J

Difference between letters is not constant in PSUX.

Hence, PSUX is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

12 – 8 + 12 × 9 ÷ 3 = 9
questions.solution:
__Concepts of BODMAS rule:__

__
 
• *BODMAS has to be used when there is more than one operation in a mathematical expression. There is a sequence of certain rules that need to be followed when using the BODMAS method. *

Conditions to follow:__

__
 
• *If there is any bracket, open the bracket, then add or subtract the terms. a + (b + c) = a + b + c, a + (b - c) = a + b - c*
 
• *If there is a negative sign just open the bracket, multiply the negative sign with each term inside the bracket. a – (b + c) ⇒ a – b – c *
 
• *If there is any term just outside the bracket, multiply that outside term with each term inside the bracket. a(b + c) ⇒ ab + ac * 

Remember BODMAS Rule:__

One easy way to remember the BODMAS rule is to perform these steps:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415df2b0a808d428a4a482aa6e439d65e029a1aede312ba561c35170b6744535.png] 

Checking each option one by one:

Interchanging + and ÷

12-8div 12times 9+3=12-(2)/(3)times 9+3

12-6+3=9

Interchanging + and ×

12-8times 12+9div 3=12-96+3

15-96ne 9

Interchanging + and –

12+8-12times 9~div 3=12+8-12times 3

20-36ne 9

Interchanging – and ÷

12div 8+12times 9-3=(3)/(2)+108-3

(3)/(2)+105~ne 9

Hence, by interchanging + and ÷ we get the correct equation.

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Comments**:

All rulers are machines.

Some machines are costly items.

**Conclusions**:

I. Some rulers are costly items.

II. Some costly items are machines.

III. All costly items are machines.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/322743387e9b06708fb58f81777a59eb4fa38749190c6e58a64340d191072626.png] 

Some rulers are costly items → False (It is a possibility but not definite)

Some costly items are machines → True

All costly items are machines → False (It is a possibility but not definite)

Hence,only conclusion II follows.

DIG → D = 4, I = 9, G =7 → 4 + 9 + 7 = 20, 20 + 5 = 25

Similarly,

KICK → K = 11, I =9, C = 3, K = 11 → 11 + 9 + 3 + 11 = 34, 34 + 5= 39

Hence, 39 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(9, 35, 16)
questions.solution:
Pattern followed is:

(√1st + √3rd) × 5 = 2ⁿd term

(√9 + √16) × 5 = (3 + 4) × 5 = 35

Similarly,

(√36 + √25) × 5 = (6 + 5) × 5 = 55

Hence, (36, 55, 25) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which number will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

3, 7, 16, 35, ?, 153
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e96183237382bb5662b478bc7d3be08934aabbb69cc87a4fd7f2d1184db26b39.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"74".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

7 – 3 = 4

7 + (4 × 2 + 1) = 16

16 – 7 = 9

16 + (9 × 2 + 1) = 35

35 – 16 = 19

**35 + (19 × 2 + 1) = 74 **

74 – 35 = 39

74 + (39 × 2 + 1) = 153

Hence, 74 is the correct answer.

questions.question: Rs. 1,875 is divided among A, B and C in such a way that A’s share is half of the combined share of B and C, and B’s share is one-fourth of the combined share of A and C. By what amount is C’s share more than that of A?
questions.solution:
A + B + C = 1875 → (1)

B + C = 2A

A + C = 4B

Putting value of B + C in equation 1,

2A + A = 1875

A = 625

Putting value of A + C in equation 1,

4B + B = 1875

B = 375

Putting values of A and B in equation 1,

625 + 375 + C = 1875

C = 875

C – A = 875 – 625 = 250

Hence, 250 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown. Which number will be at the top if 6 is at the bottom?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dce45b65ab0772f66aacea3c8bd0547d7c394ae5e06347539cc7bdb6d96d1626.png]
questions.solution:
In 1st cube 5 and 6 are adjacent face to 1

If we turn the 2ⁿd cube so that 1 faces towards front then 3 will be opposite of 5.

4 is opposite of 1 as it is not adjacent to 1 in any diagrams.

So, 6 and 2 will be opposite to each other.

Hence, 2 will be at top when 6 is at bottom.
